title: Area & Perimeter

problems_fixed.what: Semicircle area, diameter 14: stored answer was a rounding/pi=3.14 slip. Correct: 0.5*pi*7^2 = 76.969 -> 77.0 cm^2 (1 d.p.), not 76.9.
Running track (two 100 m straights + two semicircles diameter 60): flat-wrong stored answer. Correct: 200 + pi*60 = 388.496 -> 388 m. Also fixed the misconception message that stated 389.
Triangle base 14, height 5 gave area 35, a duplicate of bronze[0] (rectangle 7x5 = 35). Re-posed as height 6 -> area 42 to clear the within-tier duplicate on the single_value conversion.
Was a formula-identification multiple_choice (pick pi*r+2r). Re-posed as a numeric semicircle perimeter (radius 5) so it fits the guided single_value format: pi*5 + 2*5 = 25.7 cm.
problems_fixed.old: MC: perimeter of a semicircle radius r

opener_concept: A kitchen floor of square tiles, 5 across and 3 down (shown as an SVG grid). Counting the 15 tiles that fill it IS area (length x width); walking the 16 tile-lengths round the edge IS perimeter (2(l+w)). Names both concepts by common-sense counting before any formula.
